_comment: Single source of truth for every name, number and third-party id on the site. Anything the owner must supply is an empty string; build.py refuses to build for production while a required one is empty.
PRICE_NOTE: מחיר השקה · כולל מע״מ · משלוח והרכבה בכל הארץ
_RETENTION_NOTE: No retention period is published while none is decided: privacy.html states the lifecycle that actually exists (leads have no TTL, events 180 days, sessions 400 days). Set one, implement it in api/handler.py, then state it.
